sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. SS Rajpurohit, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 16/04/2024
The present fourth bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.86/2021 of Police Station Shri Balaji,
District Nagaur for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(W)(II), 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act.

entities.text:
Police Station Shri Balaji,
District Nagaur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Earlier third bail application was dismissed as not pressed vide order dated 12.10.2023 by this Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the case is at fag-end and the trial is yet pending.
The petitioner is inside the jail since 21.07.2021.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.

Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the prayer for bail application.
[2024:RJ-JD:16499] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-4267/2024] I have considered the arguments advanced before me and carefully gone through the record.
As many as ten prosecution witnesses have already been examined before the trial Court and the present case is at fag-end.

In these circumstances,
Prema Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:16499) on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189645682/
1 without expressing any opinion on merit and demerit of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant benefit of bail to the petitioner.

entities.text: Prema Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:16499)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the above circumstances, the fourth bail application filed by the petitioner is hereby rejected.
However, trial Court is directed to conclude the trial within a period of four months from receiving the certified copy of this order.
The trial court may hear the case on day-to-day basis.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 202-arjun/-
